edition.notes: Catalog-level record created 2026-07-25. First tome ('controversias tres generales complectens') of the 1721 Venice printing, with a dedication to Francesco I Farnese mentioning the Bernini-associated funerary monument. The book divisions of the three general controversies (De Verbo Dei 4 books; De Christo 5; De Summo Pontifice 5) were checked in the public Internet Archive scan bub_gb_B0G1UjyRYyIC; no exact artifact is registered here.
edition.title: Disputationum de controversiis tomus primus (Venice: Malachinus, 1721)

work.author: Robert Bellarmine
work.description: Bellarmine's systematic controversial theology, grown from his Roman College lectures; first published at Ingolstadt in three tomes (1586, 1588, 1593) and subsequently in four tomes of 'general controversies'. Editions differ materially in arrangement and revision; edition identity must be stated for any exact locus.
work.title: Disputationes de controversiis christianae fidei adversus huius temporis haereticos
